description: This file is a C++ source code for a model comparison tool in the PyTorch framework. It loads two TorchScript models, runs inference multiple times, compares outputs with specified tolerances, and reports success rates. It also handles input generation, threading, and output printing.

methods.name: bool checkRtol(const at::Tensor & diff,const std::vector<at::Tensor> & inputs,float tolerance,bool report)
methods.description: Compares the difference tensor to a tolerance based on the maximum input tensor value to determine if outputs are within acceptable variance.

methods.name: void report_pass_rate(int passed,int total)
methods.description: Reports the number of times model outputs passed within the specified tolerance as a percentage.

methods.name: std::vector<std::string> split(char separator,const std::string & string,bool ignore_empty=true)
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a separator character.

methods.name: std::vector<c10::IValue> create_inputs(std::vector<c10::IValue> & refinputs,std::vector<c10::IValue> & inputs,std::string & refbackend,std::string & backend,const int range_min,const int range_max)
methods.description: Generates input tensors based on specified dimensions, types, and formats, to feed into models during testing.

methods.name: void run_check(float tolerance)
methods.description: Loads models, runs inference multiple times, compares outputs, and reports overall success based on tolerance.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, sets up environment, and starts multiple threads to run model comparisons.
